scope: localization-only instrumentation and short queue; no new hardware or release qualification
engine_basis: native28 held-b; no PLE repair; existing runtime files and compiled libraries remain byte-identical

leaves.name: localization-wrappers
leaves.equivalence: Separate general-plugin wrappers call the original once with identical arguments and return its exact result or re-raise its exception; prelaunch JSON goes to flushed stderr on each rank. Configurable none/native/decode/both barriers add torch.cuda.synchronize in the active native scope or re-entered real decode scope. PP transfers are labeled but never synchronized by this plugin. Each call has a per-process call_id; end follows the barrier. Before/after barrier samples record torch.cuda.mem_get_info free/total and memory_reserved. Failures retain the last sample without querying CUDA again.
leaves.cannot_prove: Barriers change timing and can mask races. A sync failure identifies a boundary, not necessarily the original kernel; async cross-stream errors may surface later. No performance claim.

leaves.name: prior-qualification-diagnostic-skip
leaves.replaces: Current-epoch row1/rule4 controls/candidate collection and full qualification grading before row4
leaves.equivalence: Owner-authorized skip based on prior unchanged-engine receipts. The existing NativePlacementRunner runs exactly once with fresh current-epoch control, eight-stream cohort, native prefill, observer and cleanup. No old artifact is relabeled as current evidence.
leaves.cannot_prove: No fresh correctness/rule4 qualification and no release qualification. Localization PASS only means the requested diagnostic completed with required receipts.

leaves.name: cpu-launch-and-sync-fixtures
leaves.replaces: CUDA dispatch, event/stream/device synchronization and rank-local worker objects during hub tests
leaves.equivalence: Deterministic CPU callees and CUDA adapters record prelaunch/write/flush/original/sync/return order, preserve result identity, inject a sync failure and check all four rank labels and PP exclusion. Actual image plugin discovery and mounted source targets are checked separately. The plugin.sync seam supplies a deterministic CPU barrier or injected error in the wrapper unit tests.
leaves.cannot_prove: No GPU execution, green-context or NCCL behavior; no hardware timing or fault reproduction.

leaves.name: cpu-queue-and-control-fixtures
leaves.replaces: Box systemctl/Docker/restore side effects and loopback placement transport during hub tests
leaves.equivalence: Real Bash exit-trap ordering is exercised with local CPU command fixtures; actual restore functions are byte-equal to native28 and the complete inherited regression remains required. CLI tests verify direct one-shot placement, JSON prefill input and no fabricated qualification digest. Staging declaration drops the engine-stopped/idle prerequisite only; these checks move to explicit --arm. Existing launcher/defaults hashes and exact frozen self-run are checked during staging while production may serve. The qd.NativePlacementRunner, qd.QualificationDriver and qual._workload_object seams replace transport/workload construction only in the direct-CLI unit test.
leaves.cannot_prove: Cannot guarantee remote service stop or restoration; queue restores only after confirmed stopped state and retains failure evidence otherwise. Only owner runs the queue.

leaves.name: cpu-driver-registration-only
leaves.replaces: libcuda.so.1 resolution while importing real pinned-image Worker and native modules on the CPU hub
leaves.equivalence: External CPU probe prepends the image CUDA stub directory in its own process only. It imports and wraps the real mounted modules and verifies torch.cuda.is_initialized remains false. No device operation is executed. The production plugin, launcher and worker environment do not reference this stub.
leaves.cannot_prove: No CUDA driver or native device operation validation. This bootstrap is never invoked by the box queue.

leaves.name: cpu-identity-docker-and-elapsed-cost
leaves.replaces: Docker inspect/image metadata/exec transport and full181.95GB box mount-hash wall time during CPU identity tests
leaves.equivalence: Actual engine_identity capture/check CLI and real identity_probe hash fixture active files through a fake Docker executable; active-source mutation must fail. An explicit elapsed-cost adapter raises the real subprocess.TimeoutExpired when the passed timeout is below the owner-reported170.5s capture cost, reproducing old120 refusal; configured360 must complete real fixture hashing/check. Safe failure phase/kind/time fields must exclude private canaries. The same frozen identity files run in the pinned image with the plugin environment. fixtures.TMP redirects fixture files to the CPU temporary directory; sys.argv supplies the capture CLI; identity.subprocess.run (the subprocess.run seam) supplies the declared modeled Docker delay.
leaves.cannot_prove: Fixture files do not reproduce181.95GB I/O bandwidth or future box contention;360s is measured-history headroom, not a performance guarantee. Fake Docker/cost adapters never run in the owner queue.

leaves.name: snapshot-headroom-and-dual-log-fixtures
leaves.replaces: Host MemAvailable/cgroup samples, operator clock, and per-rank stdout/stderr placement records during CPU tests
leaves.equivalence: Real gate arithmetic and clock boundaries execute on explicit scalar fixtures; both real log parser inputs are graded together. The 512 MiB/worker snapshot cap exceeds the measured 52852723-byte worst retained full11/full12/teacher12 snapshot; unchanged 5 GiB transient margin yields a 7 GiB gate. Actual host sampling and snapshot cap enforcement remain active. time.time is the explicit CPU clock seam for both actual guard bodies.
leaves.cannot_prove: Older snapshot measurements do not bound the current engine. Snapshots exceeding 512 MiB refuse without truncation. Point headroom does not guarantee future peak. CPU logs and clocks do not prove box execution or cross-rank plan agreement.

leaves.name: passive-host-receipts
leaves.replaces: Direct pool constructors/copies, staged-write apply, runner batch gather, native factory admit, request registration, worker startup and qualification calls; separate diagnostic wrappers only
leaves.equivalence: Every original is invoked exactly once with identical args/result/exception. CPU mirrors only: idx_mapping_np, staged Python lists, num_blocks.np, shapes and tensor pointer metadata without emitting addresses. Counters record successful observed copy_to_uva calls since instrumentation; constructor_observed distinguishes full lifetime coverage. Existing native segment event weakrefs can be queried at predicted slot reuse, always coverage-incomplete, with no new event/allocation/sync. Bound violations are receipts and never reject execution. 512 pools/4096 traversal nodes, 262144 host elements, 128 KiB per logical record, checksummed fragments below 4 KiB per physical line, 16 MiB and 20000 physical records per rank; one explicit limit receipt then host logging stops, counters continue. The CPU fixture executes the actual pinned UvaBufferPool source with its UvaBuffer allocation and torch.Tensor type replaced by CPU NumPy/view objects; no real UVA allocation. host.pool_state raises only in the diagnostic-failure unit test; host.MAX_BYTES_PER_RANK is lowered only in the bounded-output unit test.
leaves.cannot_prove: Host mirrors do not prove device values or correctness. Existing native events cover only associated native descriptor consumers and may already be destroyed; ordinary decode/UVA-backed readers are not covered. A possible_step_wrap or pending sample does not establish corruption. Predicted entry slot may change under concurrent callers; returned pointer metadata identifies a slot for event association when still present. No device readback, synchronization, allocation, execution refusal or memory ownership change is introduced by receipts. Default none can expose timing-sensitive behavior, but D also adds host logging overhead.

leaves.name: cpu-exact-row4-cli-network-boundary
leaves.replaces: http.client.HTTPConnection.request at the first FULL prepare send; sys.argv and os.environ input adapters only
leaves.equivalence: Real main parses the argv extracted from this exact frozen queue. Real bundle workload and prefill JSON, manifest validation, typed CLI fields, ImmutableStore, authenticated loopback target, route-bank import and freeze_prefill_plan execute unchanged. Synthetic environment auth is checked at the HTTP send boundary, which raises ConnectionRefusedError before a socket is used. Exactly one prepare attempt and the expected transport refusal prove validation completed. Parent path-as-object refusal and an invalid plan are rejected before any HTTP attempt. sys.argv supplies the exact expanded queue argv; os.environ supplies only synthetic CPU auth.
leaves.cannot_prove: No live service, engine execution, all-rank acknowledgements, GPU behavior or subsequent placement sequence is exercised. Expected network refusal is not a GPU success.
